name: rosetta-moser-s-circle-problem
code:
use default

polynomial(n: int) -> int =>
    (n * n * n * n - 6 * n * n * n + 23 * n * n - 18 * n + 24) / 24

choose(n: int, k: int) -> int =>
    if k > n then
        0
    else
        (1..k + 1)
        |> reduce(1, (total, step) => total * (n - k + step) / step)
    fi

binomials(n: int) -> int => choose(n, 4) + choose(n, 2) + 1

write_line("{"n",3}{"polynomial",14}{"binomials",14}")

for n in 1..21 do
    write_line("{n,3}{polynomial(n),14}{binomials(n),14}")
od
